organic.text: Look for a corporate travel-and-expense platform that connects booking with expense reporting. Evaluate whether it supports the flights, hotels and ground transport your team needs; applies travel policies and approval workflows before booking; and offers support for changes or disruptions. For automatic expense capture, check corporate-card transaction imports, receipt scanning, emailed-receipt ingestion and matching receipts to transactions. Ask which steps are genuinely automatic and which still require employee review. Confirm accounting integrations, reimbursement workflows, multi-currency handling, tax documentation, security controls and availability in your operating countries. Compare total costs, including subscriptions, booking fees, support fees and implementation. Pilot with a few travelers: book a trip, change it, capture both card and out-of-pocket expenses, then export an approved report to accounting. Your company size, countries, existing cards and accounting software will help narrow the choice.

organic.text:
Look for a corporate travel platform that combines flight, hotel, and rail booking with expense management. Evaluate whether it can automatically import booking receipts and corporate-card transactions, capture emailed or photographed receipts, match expenses, and flag missing documentation. Confirm what is truly automatic versus requiring employee review.

Key criteria: travel-policy enforcement, approval workflows, traveler support during disruptions, booking coverage in your main regions, accounting integrations, reimbursement workflows, multi-currency handling, and reporting. Ask how it handles changes, cancellations, refunds, personal spending, and duplicate receipts.

For a demo, test one trip end to end: book within policy, change the itinerary, capture a hotel receipt and meal expense, match card charges, approve the report, and export it to accounting. Compare total costs, including platform, booking, support, and integration fees. Your company size, travel regions, existing accounting system, and corporate-card setup will determine the best fit.
